name: Baking With Chocolate
source:
Baking With Chocolate is a kinetic VN focused on butts, black women and breeding.

After sleeping with the dean’s wife and getting fired in spectacular fashion, your academic career is over. With nothing left to lose, you sell everything but your car and move to a quiet small town in New York to start over as the owner of a local bakery.

A normal, peaceful life sounds nice. Too bad you have absolutely no intention of living one.

What begins as innocent conversations with your neighbor Monique soon spirals into late-night visits, private tutoring sessions, family drama, jealousy, manipulation, and enough bad decisions to destroy several relationships.

As your bakery becomes famous for its delicious cream pies, you’ll slowly work your way through the town’s tangled relationships while seducing, corrupting, and reshaping the people around you.

Tutor Monique’s daughters Tasha and LaDesha while pushing them far beyond their original goals. Turn LeShawn’s growing hatred of you into open rivalry as his family slips further from his control. Break down Barquisha’s bitter attitude and transform the town’s angriest woman into your obedient personal bimbo. Pull Andre’s girlfriend Channel away from him while her deeply conservative mother Beatrice struggles against desires she never imagined having.

And through all of it, try to keep the bakery running. Or not, we're here for the creampies.

BWC is an adult kinetic visual novel focused on comedy, corruption, seduction, and chaotic relationship drama, featuring an ass of a protagonist who's fresh start quickly becomes every husband's problem.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4622930/Baking_With_Chocolate/]Steam[/url]]
